# Synthetic fixtures

These pages and every name, URL, product, price, and sentence inside them were
created for OmniScrape. They do not reproduce third-party website content and
may be used under the repository's MIT license.

- `article.html`: JSON-LD plus semantic article markup.
- `product.html`: schema.org Product and Offer data.
- `redirect-target.html`: stable destination used by mocked redirect tests.
- `security.html`: inert hostile-looking markup for sanitization and URL-safety
  regression tests. It is never opened in a browser.
